name: electoral-areas-2025
title: Constituencies and electoral areas of Uganda, 2025
description: Electoral Commission constituencies and the electoral areas of directly elected district, municipality and sub-county councillors from the 2025 demarcation, linked to the districts, counties, sub-counties and parishes of this portal.

sources.title: Electoral Commission of Uganda: Display list of demarcated electoral areas for local government council elections 2025

knownIssues: Polling stations are not included: the Electoral Commission has not published a list of them in a usable form.
Women councillor electoral areas (which group several areas) are not included.
Constituencies are linked to the county of the same name; municipality constituencies are linked to the municipal council at district level, with no county.
Electoral areas are linked by name to sub-counties and parishes; the Electoral Commission codes and names as published are kept.

changelog.note: First publication: 353 constituencies and 13,331 electoral areas.
